sensory_dominance_hierarchy.description: Visual register highly activated; Kairi is observer first, participant second
key_registers: color-discrimination, especially white/snow versus colored objects
distance-judgment, including elevated and foothill perspectives
detail-capture, including small gestures, micro-expressions, and textile patterns
montage-composition, with scenes perceived as collage rather than linear sequence
examples: Yuki's hands performing origami, including finger position and paper crease angles
Anna's hāfu face perceived under different lighting conditions
Atsuo's hands around a coffee cup, paternal touch anchored through an object
Reira's red lipstick reflected in a mirror, associated with desire and forbidden threshold

sensory_dominance_hierarchy.description: Flavor-memory functions as emotional anchor; food operates as a primary connection language
key_registers: sugar, including the sugar-cube oath, wagashi, and amazake
umami, including miso, dashi, and kissaten cooking
temperature, including hot tea communion and cold-water shock
bitterness avoided in favor of comfort-oriented tastes
examples: Apple pie and cream, associated with Atsuo and paternal care
Yuki's cooking, associated with acceptance and family belonging
Mugicha, associated with summer familiarity and hydration
Umeboshi, associated with grandmother ritual and sour taste

sensory_dominance_hierarchy.description: Physical contact functions as a boundary and belonging marker
key_registers: hand-holding, including Anna-Kairi solidarity and non-sexual intimacy
hair-touch, including Yuki brushing Kairi's cowlick
water-touch, including Ryuji's hand in the ocean and first embodied attraction
fabric-touch, including zabuton, kotatsu blanket, and school-uniform seams
temperature-gradient, including mountain cold and kissaten warmth
sensory_dominance_hierarchy.boundary_function: touch signals belonging, care, consent, or violation

sensory_dominance_hierarchy.description: Odor functions as temporal anchor and trigger for non-verbal memory
key_registers: coffee, associated with Atsuo and kissaten identity
snow-smell, including pre-storm ozone and winter approach
perfume, including Reira's Chanel-associated memory marker
ocean-salt, associated with Ajigasawa and summer bodily awareness
woodsmoke, associated with seasonal return and time passing

sensory_dominance_hierarchy.description: Sound is sparse and high-impact; silence functions as a perceptual register
key_registers: snow-crunch, compacted snow under footsteps
bell-toll, including the 108 strikes of the New Year temple ritual
train-whistle, associated with departures and arrivals
cicada-chorus, associated with summer dusk and persistent background tension
silence itself, including Hirosaki quiet and post-train emotional void

restricted_sensory_zones.restriction: Kairi cannot taste adult-associated foods such as alcohol or strong espresso
restricted_sensory_zones.significance: maintains a child-register despite psychological growth
restricted_sensory_zones.rupture_moment: first alcohol sip (otoso at New Year's Eve 2001), associated with a rite-of-passage transition

restricted_sensory_zones.restriction: Kairi avoids looking at Reira after the discovery
restricted_sensory_zones.consequence: mother becomes increasingly unmappable and eventually absent

perceptual_disability_encoding: none; Kairi has standard sensory apparatus but uses it with heightened discrimination and poetic precision
protocol_4_1_compliance: perceptual field governs reader immersion; sensory details function as ontological anchors rather than descriptive ornament
